extension_metadata_update.base_completion: Original separate base completion CAM/UID path unchanged; optional segment never participates in WB completion.
extension_metadata_update.reader_reservation: Reserve ext row write-port before acquiring a new reader lease and before real response enqueue/bank service; no response accepted then charged retroactively.
extension_metadata_update.same_row_merge: Begin+response/cancel may combine only for the exact same row incarnation in one cycle; different row uses HOLD. A granted cycle is not refunded after cancellation.

query.cancellation: spent port/cycle never refunded; one existing head request only
query.sharing: base and extension segments serialize on the same frontend query gate; no ext peek before actual base ABSENT
query.ticket: existing row7/incarnation64 plus1 segment bit; snapshot UID32/line64 and phase/valid while second lookup pending

retention.allocation: reuse SAME existing clean victim Payload handle, same physical bank. No copy/new Data allocation for retained victim itself. Landing still reserves an actual free same-bank Payload slot under original allocator.
retention.replacement: extension128 uses original age policy within that segment only; no new full256 parallelCAM or free global selector
retention.rule: Keep original base128 policy when a base EMPTY exists; on clean eviction when base would displace optional data, prefer extension LRU destination if its finite update port is available. Otherwise preserve original opportunistic fallback; never stall mandatoryWB to retain optional data.

scope_limits: WV-only finite U16/P1, no RO/M/T/ideal/FIXED64 compositions
Runtime gpgpu_flush_l2_cache=1 not initially qualified; explicit source config rejection required if lifecycle cannot be timed safely

Initial quiescent host prefill before optional allocation supported; post-allocation interleaved host prefill/flush must fail safely or receive a timed implementation before qualification; no silent extra lookup/free cleanup
No claims of net performance improvement until sameSource legacy/cost-control/enabled applications accepted

write_atomic_ext_hit.lower: Any dirty resident replacement still requires base128 WAD/lower/landing pre-reservation before original native enqueue. Extension never becomes WB_STAGED or WB_INFLIGHT.
write_atomic_ext_hit.rule: Do not perform cross-segment dirty promotion in this safety-limited version. After paid ext lookup, if no reader/pending owner, invalidate clean ext row using its finite metadata write port and release its clean Payload, then perform the original native miss/atomic path.
write_atomic_ext_hit.stalls: Pinned ext reader or busy ext write port causes backpressure; no drop of pinned/dirty state.
